copy.title: App Toolkit: Everyday tools in one app
copy.headline: Everyday tools, one app
copy.description: App Toolkit for Android: Water Eject, Ruler and Protractor, Unit Converter, Tip and Bill Splitter, Decision Wheel and more, in one app.
copy.longDescription: Each tool opens its own world from its store listing: sound waves and bubbles leave the speaker for Water Eject, the ruler and protractor measure 45 degrees, 1 m becomes 100 cm, a receipt prints each person's share and the decision wheel lands in confetti, before the tools gather as App Toolkit.
copy.altText: App Toolkit's tools each open a coloured world on a Pixel phone: speaker waves, a ruler and protractor, unit shapes, a receipt and a spinning wheel with confetti.
